## About

David Vique is a Senior Full Stack AI Engineer based in Ecuador with 5+ years of experience
building AI-driven SaaS products, automation pipelines, voice agents, and serverless cloud systems
for US and European clients. End-to-end ownership: frontend, backend, DevOps, and AI integrations.

9+ products shipped. Springer BICA 2023 paper (Vol. 1130). Triathlon finisher (1.5 km swim · 40 km bike · 10 km run).
